text: BAM share fell 0.07 percentage points over 26 hours but remains up 1.33 percentage points over 7 days, at 35.7%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 24.8% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes in this window fit whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated, with 22 minutes of warning.
